# Aniron

Font by Pete Klassen (2004), a replica of the credits lettering of Peter Jackson's
*The Lord of the Rings* trilogy. © Pete Klassen, all rights reserved; distributed by the
author as **free for personal use only** — no commercial use, no modification
(https://www.dafont.com/aniron.font). The author's original readme is alongside.

It is bundled here because this app is a private, non-commercial birthday gift. If this
project is ever published or used commercially, replace Aniron (e.g. with Cinzel or
Uncial Antiqua, both SIL OFL) or obtain a commercial license from the author.
